preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 30.
The number of swap operations is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in str)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only digits from 0 to 9.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(str[i:] for i in range(len(str)))
postconditions.description: The output string is the lexicographically largest string that can be obtained by performing at most K swap operations on the input string.
